summary: Removed 53-ft timber lookout on Jack Mountain, Jefferson County, MT; built 1965 per newspaper (register says 1964), torn down 2011, foundation posts remain.

facts.design: 53-ft treated timber tower with R-6 cab
facts.status_note: Torn down in 2011; foundation posts and a survey benchmark remain per peakbagging.com

visit.trail_note: A picture-tour page advises a hike to the former site from Basin; no other source checked gives route or road details.

events.note: Completed 1965 per a 1965 Montana Standard-Post item (quoted on montanalookouts.weebly.com); firelookout.com and peakbagging.com also say 1965. FFLOS register lists 1964.
Replaced the old, unsafe lookout station on Thunderbolt Mountain, which was removed.
Not used for fire detection purposes after 1984 (FFLOS description). Not an explicit staffing date.
Torn down in 2011 (firelookout.com; FFLOS Removed field). A picture-tour page says removed for safety reasons.
Date registered March 24, 2020; nominated by Calvin Schneckloth.

corrections.proposed: 1965 (register figure 1964 kept as a noted conflict)
corrections.why: The 1965 Montana Standard-Post item (quoted on montanalookouts.weebly.com), firelookout.com and peakbagging.com all date the tower to 1965. Only the FFLOS register gives 1964. Editor should decide which to publish.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS register says 1964; the 1965 newspaper item and firelookout.com and peakbagging.com say 1965. The story uses 1965 and says the register gives 1964.

A picture-tour page says removed for safety reasons in 2011. A search snippet from a Montana Standard article (not read; HTTP 429 on fetch) suggests the lookout was overtaken by technology. The story gives only the picture-tour page's reason.

notes_for_editor: Brief build year 1964 (FFLOS) conflicts with three sources saying 1965; the story gives 1965 and notes the register figure. The removal reason is thin: the only read source is a picture-tour page that says safety reasons; a Montana Standard article returned HTTP 429 and a search snippet mentions technology overtaking the site, so verify the reason before publishing. Remains (foundation posts, 1986 benchmark) come from peakbagging.com, undated. Access: no source gives a road or trail route or a public-access status, so none is stated; the picture-tour page only advises a hike. Page reads and searches are used up. Photos: firelookout.com credits Dale Osborne and peakbagging.com has photos, but no image URLs were captured, so none added. Fact-check note: the same picture-tour page also says many Montana lookouts are being razed to reduce liability costs and that this one was no exception; the story gives only the safety reason, so check that reason before publishing.
